prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandstone canyon floor in front of the rose-red Treasury at Petra, a smooth sandy path and standard-height rock-cut doorways, empty of tourists, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Norwegian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a copper pyramid-shaped lump, a copper square-sided cowbell, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold ship's anchor, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold hair ornaments. Hands and nails are part of the lattice.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both legs and both feet — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of ONE rebar sculpture, like a three-dimensional drawing made of thick ribbed steel rebar bars bent into the shape of the body: bundled and crossing rebar bars form every part of her figure — her chest, torso, both arms, both hands with every finger, and both legs and both feet are nothing but rebar, with no solid surface and no real limb, chest or skin anywhere; the rebar lines are heavy and overlapping in the middle of each part and the surroundings show through between them, with no concrete anywhere, each ribbed bar catching its own glint, built as one open lattice sculpture like a statue, with no real body, no skin and no flesh anywhere inside or beneath the rebar. Her two legs stay clearly separate all the way down, made of the same material to the tips of her toes, standing directly on the ground with a soft contact shadow. Everything below the collarbones is an open lattice with wide gaps, so the surroundings and their light show straight through between the lines, while her real face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh, and the rebar edge rises in a small raised step at the base of the neck.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same rebar lattice, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Kenyan person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome young man's idol face with a clean sharp jawline, straight thick brows and defined expressive eyes, a very faint trace of stubble, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, deep ebony skin with a soft glow, a calm easy look, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a bronze cube-shaped block, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold anklets. Extra long nails in matching polished lapis lazuli.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished lapis lazuli fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep royal-blue lapis surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID golden pyrite flecks scattered through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved lapis lazuli.

RIGHT Cracks: the lapis lazuli body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right thigh, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right upper arm and one at her left calf, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-blue stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the lapis lazuli is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: one hand resting on her lower back, the other hanging down, back gently arched.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme strappy platform stiletto sandals in tan leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved lapis lazuli right down to the shoes.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
